info.title: LightNVR API
info.description:
Specified from the C handlers in src/web (serialization and parsing code read directly), not from prose documentation. Where the C behavior and the UI or docs disagree, operation descriptions record the C wire behavior and the disagreement is recorded as a discrepancy (D-xx in quality/api-inventory.json) or a finding candidate (F-T11-xx in quality/evidence/T11.md). Extension keywords (`x-lightnvr-*`) are annotations: they never change validation results. The schemas additionally enforce explicit client-input and response-redaction policies: they do not claim that every currently accepted request or emitted response conforms. Known violations are recorded in the fixtures and findings, with expected_server_response separate from schema validity.
Compatibility policy: response objects are open (unknown additional keys are compatible) except where a schema states otherwise for redaction reasons; request bodies are closed. Errors use `{"error": "<message>"}`.

servers.description: Same origin as the web UI.

tags.name: pilot-option-dependency
tags.description: Read-only endpoints the Streams list/edit UI loads to populate options and gating.

inventoried_not_specified: GET /api/streams/{name} (unwrapped single stream; same object as /full .stream)
all other routes in quality/api-inventory.json routes[]

partially_specified.note: the legacy (non-summary) array is schema-described via LegacyStreamList but is out of pilot and not contract-tested.
enable_disabled and set_privacy_mode are described because they share the operation, but their flows are out of pilot.

get.summary: List streams (paged summary for the pilot; legacy full list otherwise)
get.description: Authentication is checked first (401). With `summary=true` (or `1`) the paged summary variant is returned; its row shape depends on `surface`. Rows are filtered per camera: `admin`/`live` require live.view, `lpr` requires both lpr.search and lpr.read. `can_configure` is the per-camera camera.configure decision. Query parameters are validated in this order: page/page_size, sort_by, sort_order, surface, availability. Without `summary`, the legacy unbounded array of full stream objects is returned (out of pilot; no current web/js caller) and every other query parameter is ignored.

x-lightnvr-authz.authentication: required (demo mode grants a viewer pseudo-user; auth disabled grants admin)

parameters.name: summary
parameters.description: Exactly `true` or `1` selects the summary variant; any other value (including `TRUE`) selects the legacy list.

parameters.name: surface
parameters.description: Invalid value: 400 "surface must be admin, live or lpr".

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Decimal integer parsed by strtol: leading whitespace and a plus sign are accepted, but trailing whitespace/suffixes are rejected. Empty or out of range: 400 "page and page_size must be positive; page_size max is 100". A page beyond the last returns an empty `streams` array with the real totals.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Out of range: 400 "page and page_size must be positive; page_size max is 100".

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Invalid: 400 "Invalid stream summary sort field". Ties break on case-insensitive name.

parameters.name: sort_order
parameters.description: Invalid: 400 "sort_order must be asc or desc".

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring over name, camera_uuid, tags, location path and inventory address. Values longer than 255 bytes are silently truncated.

parameters.name: include_admin_url
parameters.description: Exactly `true` or `1` adds `admin_url` to rows on the admin surface (never on live/lpr). Rows without camera.configure get "".

500.description: Includes "Authorization policy evaluation failed", which is also returned for the WHOLE list when any stream lacks a fleet inventory row (finding candidate F-T11-10).

get.summary: Full stream detail used by the edit form
get.description: Order of checks: path decode (400 "Invalid request path"), stream lookup (404 "Stream not found", BEFORE authentication), configuration read (500), authentication (401), fleet row (404 "Camera not found"), live.view (403). Callers with live.view but without camera.configure receive the live-only redacted variant; `can_control_privacy` equals the camera.configure decision and selects the variant. The response is wrapped as `{"stream": {...}}` (GET /api/streams/{name}, out of pilot, returns the same object unwrapped). The handler never emits `detection_zones` (D-02); zones come from GET /api/streams/{name}/zones.

200.description: Stream detail, configure or live-only variant.

put.description: Order of checks: path decode (400 "Invalid request path"), stream lookup (404 "Stream not found", BEFORE authentication), configuration read (500), camera.configure authorization (401/404 "Camera not found"/403) BEFORE the body is parsed, then body parse (400 "Invalid JSON in request body" for an empty or unparsable body). Fields are applied in handler order; the first failing validation returns its error and nothing is stored. Present keys with the wrong JSON type are silently ignored (F-T11-05). A valid JSON body that is not an object (e.g. `null`, `[]`) is accepted as a no-op 202 (F-T11-04). If `isOnvif` is omitted the server recomputes it from whether `url` contains "onvif" (F-T11-11). When the effective isOnvif is true the handler copies onvif_username/onvif_password/onvif_profile, moves URL credentials into them, and runs an ONVIF connection test inline before responding; when false those three keys are ignored. `set_privacy_mode` short-circuits: after all other keys were parsed and validated (and `enable_disabled` already executed) it writes only privacy_mode and answers 200; other edits in the same body are discarded (F-T11-12). Otherwise the response is 202 and a detached worker applies the change; the 202 does not prove persistence. Errors in the 400 set: "playback_transport is invalid", "eptz_config must be a JSON string", "eptz_config exceeds size limit", "eptz_config is not a supported version-1 equidistant ceiling configuration", "retention_days must be between -1 and 365", "detection_retention_days must be between -1 and 365", "detection_url must use http, https, rtsp, or rtsps", "publish_url destinations must be rtmp:// or rtmps:// URLs". 413 set: "detection_url exceeds size limit", "publish_url exceeds size limit".

x-lightnvr-authz.required: camera.configure (per camera), checked before body parse

202.description: Update accepted; applied asynchronously by a worker thread.

get.summary: Detection zones for a stream (read by the edit modal and ZoneEditor)
get.description: No pre-auth existence check: 401 first, then 404 "Camera not found" for unknown names, 403 without live.view. Path decode failure is 400 "Invalid stream name". POST/DELETE on this path are out of pilot.

get.summary: Detection model options for the edit form
get.description: 401 unauthenticated; 403 unless the principal has global camera.configure or camera.configure on at least one camera. Viewers therefore receive 403 and the UI shows no models (D-04).

200.description: Built-in models first (motion, api-detection, onvif), then file models.

get.summary: Current principal (role and demo-mode gating for the Streams UI)
get.description: Three 200 shapes: authentication disabled (synthetic admin), a real authenticated user, or demo-mode anonymous viewer. Uses httpd_get_authenticated_user (scoped API tokens are not accepted here although the streams handlers accept them). 401 also clears the session cookie. An authenticated user in demo mode receives no `demo_mode` key (F-T11-13).

ErrorResponse.description: Error envelope used for every non-2xx JSON response in the pilot. Produced only by http_response_set_json_error(), which emits exactly one key. Clients must not depend on the message text for control flow except where an operation documents a specific message.

Int32.description: C `int` read through cJSON `valueint` (fractional values are truncated, out-of-range values saturate). Used where the server performs no range validation of its own.

CameraUuid.description: Immutable fleet identity (36-char UUID). Legacy rows created before camera UUIDs existed may carry an empty string.

StreamName.description: Stream (camera) name as stored. This is the primary key used in paths. Names created through POST /api/streams must match `^[A-Za-z0-9_-][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$` (is_valid_stream_name), but names that predate that rule or arrive through configuration import can contain other characters, so the read-side schema only bounds the length.

PlaybackTransport.description: Responses substitute `auto` when the stored value is invalid, so a response never carries a value outside this enum.

StreamProtocol.description: Transport protocol: 0 = TCP, 1 = UDP (stream_protocol_t). PUT does not range-check this value (see finding candidate F-T11-06); the contract only permits the two defined values.

RetentionDays.description: Tri-state per-stream retention override in days. `-1` inherits the live global retention value at evaluation time, `0` is explicitly unlimited (also disables tier expiry), and `1..365` is a day override. Writes outside -1..365 are rejected with 400. For `detection_retention_days`, `-1` inherits the *global* retention value, not this stream's `retention_days`.
RetentionDays.x-lightnvr-source: include/core/config.h:stream_config_t.retention_days; src/web/api_handlers_streams_modify.c:handle_put_stream (range check); src/storage/storage_manager.c (tri-state evaluation, tier expiry skip on 0)

HourOfWeekSchedule.description: 168 booleans indexed `day * 24 + hour` in server local time, where day 0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday (struct tm tm_wday). Responses always carry exactly 168 entries. On PUT, an array whose length is not 168 is silently ignored (no error) and any entry other than JSON `true` is stored as false (finding candidate F-T11-07).

EmptyString.description: Redacted value. The server emits an empty string in place of a sensitive value.

UrlWithoutUserinfo.description: A URL-like string that carries no userinfo (`user:pass@`) in its authority. Empty string is permitted (viewer redaction falls back to "" when credential stripping fails). A response that contains userinfo here is a credential leak and must fail validation.

UrlWithoutQuerySecrets.description: Rejects a URL whose query string carries a non-empty parameter whose key contains pass, pwd, token, secret or apikey (case-insensitive). The C redaction only strips userinfo, so a camera URL like `rtsp://host/live?user=admin&password=x` currently reaches viewers unchanged. This rule is the redaction policy the contract enforces; a server response that violates it is a finding (F-T11-03), not a schema bug.

ViewerSafeUrl.description: Credential-free URL as delivered to principals without camera.configure.

SummaryForbiddenSensitiveKeys.description: Summary rows never carry credential-bearing configuration. Presence of any of these keys is a redaction failure regardless of value.

StreamSummaryLpr.description: surface=lpr row. LPR discovery grants identity only, so this object is closed: any extra key (configuration, location, health) is a policy leak.

StreamSummaryBase.description: Fields shared by admin and live summary rows (always emitted).

can_configure.description: Per-camera camera.configure decision. Authoritative for edit affordances (D-05).

StreamSummaryAdmin.description: surface=admin row. `admin_url` appears only with include_admin_url and must be "" when can_configure is false.

total.description: Rows visible to the caller after filtering.

total_pages.description: 0 when total is 0, else ceil(total / page_size).

LegacyStreamList.description: Out of pilot (inventoried, not contract-tested by T18): GET /api/streams without summary. Bare unbounded array of the same objects as the /full detail, each redacted per camera.

DetailStatus.description: Fleet health first; when health is unknown and the stream is enabled, the stream-state/UDT status is used (adds Starting/Stopping/Reconnecting).

EptzConfigString.description: "" (disabled) or JSON text of a version-1 equidistant ceiling dewarp document, at most 1023 bytes. The server stores it opaquely after validating; the document schema is EptzConfigV1.

StreamDetailBase.description: Non-sensitive fields of the full stream object, emitted for every caller with live.view. Credential-bearing keys (url, onvif_username, onvif_password, admin_url, go2rtc_source_override, sub_stream_url, detection_url, publish_url) are declared here only as strings and are NOT required; each variant pins them.

detection_threshold.description: Integer percent: (int)(stored_float * 100.0f), truncated toward zero. Not a 0..1 float on the wire.

has_sub_stream.description: Presence of a sub-stream; visible to viewers by design.

error_message.description: Present only when status is Error and a cause was recorded (currently model-load failures).

StreamDetailConfigurable.description: Admin edit model: caller has camera.configure on this camera (can_control_privacy = true). Sensitive fields carry real values. When separate credentials are in use (isOnvif, or non-empty onvif_username/onvif_password) the server strips userinfo from `url` and surfaces it through the onvif_* fields.

StreamDetailLiveOnly.description: Viewer (live.view without camera.configure) model. Every credential-bearing key is OPTIONAL (a server that stops sending it is compatible) but, if present, must be redacted: onvif_* and the administrative URLs must be exactly "", and `url` must be credential-free (no userinfo, no secret-like query parameter). A leaked value therefore fails validation.

StreamDetail.description: Either variant, selected by can_control_privacy (mutually exclusive by const).

NullableClearableString.description: Clearable text field. JSON null clears the stored value (same as "").

DetectionUrl.description: "" (use main stream) or a URL whose scheme is http, https, rtsp or rtsps (case-insensitive prefix check). Other schemes: 400. >= 512 bytes: 413 (scheme is checked first). null clears.

PublishUrlList.description: "" or a comma/whitespace-separated list of rtmp:// or rtmps:// destinations. Each destination is printable ASCII without quotes or backslash and has at least one character after the scheme. Invalid list: 400; whole string >= 512 bytes: 413 (validity is checked first). null clears.

StreamUpdateRequest.description: Edit-form body. All keys optional (partial update). Closed: the server ignores unknown keys (including `name` and the UI's `is_deleted`, D-01) but the contract rejects them so client drift is visible. Wrong-typed values are silently ignored by the server (F-T11-05). Top-level numeric fields have no server-side range checks except retention (F-T11-06); the JSON embedded in eptz_config is separately range-checked. Over-long strings are silently truncated unless `x-lightnvr-overflow` says otherwise (F-T11-14).

url.description: Not validated (an empty string is accepted). A change requires a stream restart.

enable_disabled.description: Out of pilot (enable/bulk-enable). `true` re-enables a disabled stream synchronously, even when the same body also carries set_privacy_mode.

codec.description: Codec hint; the UI sends "" (auto), "h264" or "h265". Not validated.

detection_model.description: Copied through a 256-byte buffer although the stored field holds 511 bytes.

detection_threshold.description: Percent; stored as value / 100.0 (float). Not range-checked.

isOnvif.description: When omitted the server recomputes it from `url` containing "onvif" (F-T11-11). The UI always sends it.

onvif_username.description: Applied only when the effective isOnvif is true; "" clears the stored value (no "unchanged" sentinel).

onvif_password.description: Applied only when the effective isOnvif is true; "" clears the stored value (no "unchanged" sentinel).

onvif_profile.description: Applied only when the effective isOnvif is true.

motion_trigger_source.description: Another stream's name; existence is not checked.

go2rtc_source_override.description: Whitespace-only is stored as "". Not YAML-validated by PUT.

StreamPrivacyModeRequest.description: Live privacy toggle (used by Live video cells, not the edit form). Modelled as its own closed body because the server discards every other edit when this key is present (F-T11-12).

message.const: Stream update request accepted and processing

onvif_status.description: Present when the effective isOnvif was true and the inline ONVIF test ran.

StreamPrivacyModeResponse.description: Always success:true, even if the database write failed (the failure is only logged; F-T11-12).

id.description: Built-ins use motion, api-detection, onvif; file models use the absolute file path.

type.description: Observed values include builtin, api, onvif, sod, sod_realnet, tflite.

size.description: File size in bytes (file models only).

message.description: Present only when the models directory cannot be opened.

StreamNamePath.name: name
StreamNamePath.description: Stream name, percent-encoded as one path segment (the UI uses encodeURIComponent). Routing matches the *encoded* segment against `#` (a run of non-'/' characters), then http_request_extract_path_param decodes it with form semantics: `%XX` is decoded and a literal `+` becomes a space, so a name containing '+' must be sent as `%2B`. The entire encoded suffix after `/api/streams/` must be shorter than 256 bytes, including `/full` or `/zones`. Thus the encoded name limit is 255 bytes for PUT, 250 for `/full`, and 249 for `/zones`. Overflow answers 400 "Invalid request path" ("Invalid stream name" for zones; finding candidate F-T11-09). Names whose decoded form contains '/' (sent as `%2F`) are truncated at the first '/' by the `/full` handler and resolve to a different stream (finding candidate F-T11-08). Path segments that decode to `.` or `..` are rejected by the HTTP parser before routing.

CacheControl.description: Every JSON response sets `no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate` (plus `Pragma: no-cache` and `Expires: 0`).

BadRequest.description: Malformed path, query, or body. Message text is operation-specific.

Unauthorized.description: No authenticated principal (and demo mode is off). Body is `{"error":"Unauthorized"}`.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but the authorization policy denied the action. Body is `{"error":"Forbidden"}`.

StreamNotFound.description: `{"error":"Stream not found"}` when no stream with that name is loaded. This check runs BEFORE authentication, so unauthenticated callers can distinguish existing from missing names (finding candidate F-T11-01). `{"error":"Camera not found"}` is returned after authentication when the stream exists but has no fleet inventory row.

PayloadTooLarge.description: A size-checked string field exceeded its buffer.

InternalError.description: Server-side failure (allocation, serialization, database read, or authorization policy evaluation error: `{"error":"Authorization policy evaluation failed"}`).

sessionCookie.name: session
sessionCookie.description: HttpOnly session cookie set by POST /api/auth/login.

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: API token (scoped tokens are accepted by the streams handlers but not by /api/auth/verify).

bearerAuth.description: API token presented as a bearer credential.
